additional_details: Upgrade to version 11.5 build 11500 or higher, to address this vulnerability.
search_text: published ZDI-15-221 ZDI-CAN-2455 ManageEngine OpManager NPMRequestHandler userName SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2015-05-13 10.0 ['ManageEngine'] ['OpManager'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of ManageEngine OpManager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the NPMRequestHandler servlet. The issue lies in the failure to sanitize user-supplied input prior to executing a SQL statement. An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to execute code under the context of the database, which defaults to SYSTEM. Upgrade to version 11.5 build 11500 or higher, to address this vulnerability. ['2014-08-18 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2015-05-13 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Andrea Micalizzi (rgod) https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-15-221/
